player_prompt.intro:
Uzobonyeza {N} ibijomba bitari viganwa kwa mpango.
Kuri kila gikorwa andika [accept] kugira ngo ubeze *ijomba ririkuze*, cyangwa [continue] kuyikubita ngo uone irya ririki.
Ikiwewe utabishywe, uzobashwe kuyitwara ijomba ya mwisho.
Ushobora kushyira (umuhigo = 1) **tu** ikiwa ijomba wabaye wamaze kuyitwara ni ya kijyambere zose.

outcome.summary: Wabyemeye ibijomba {value} mu kuzungusha {draw_num}/{N}. Iyi nziza yose yari {best}. {result}
outcome.perfect: Ni yo mpamvu ari we wahisemo neza.
